How to split pdf online

  1. Select a PDF from your device.
  2. Choose pages to extract or a split point.
  3. Click Create PDF files, then download your results.

This tool accepts standard PDFs without passwords. Copied pages may lose some interactive features or signatures.

Two ways to split your document

Use Extract selected pages when you need a particular chapter, receipt, or handout from a longer PDF. Page ranges such as 2-4 keep those pages together in a single downloadable PDF. Choose Split into two PDFs when dividing a document at a specific page boundary, for example separating a report from its appendix.

If you enter pages out of order, the extraction follows the order you enter. Duplicate page numbers are included only once.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to upload my PDF?

No. PDFEasy processes your file locally in your browser.

Can I extract pages like 1, 3-5?

Yes. Enter individual pages and ranges separated by commas.

Can I split into two files?

Yes. Select Split into two files, then choose the page after which to split.

Will digital signatures survive?

Editing or copying PDF pages may invalidate signatures or alter interactive features. Always check the result.
